title: I FOUND BIGFOOT #bigfootmusical #greyhensen #newmusical #musicals #th...
transcript: I went searching for bigfoot, and I found him doing eight shows a week in midtown manhattan. Bigfoot is a brand new musical comedy currently in previews at M T C. Theater. I went in knowing almost nothing about the show except for the cast and the creative team, all who I deeply love. So I guess I shouldn't have been surprised when I fell head over heels in love with the town of mud dirt. Mud dirt is a struggling small town on filled with quirky characters, like an evil mayor, a kind but bumbling doctor, and a very large, very sweet bigfoot who just wants to have friends. Bigfoot very much has shaft meets elf. Energy. Energy. I did not stop laughing. The jokes are so funny and sneakily dirty and very meta. There's also this very wholesome kind of energy about the whole thing. There are only six members of the cast, and most of them play multiple characters, and they're all so sharp and, like, incredible vocals and humor. And of course, grey henson, who looks so good. This bigfoot costume is crazy, and he is perfect. You forget that there is a human under the bigfoot. He's so committed to the role, and you just fall in love with bigfoot. The music is ridiculously catchy. Like, i've had all of the songs stuck in my head, and it's just so nice to see a truly original musical that knows exactly what it is and commits To the. It's a perfect night out with friends if you just wanna laugh for ninety straight minutes. And you'll just leave so much happier than when you walked in. Tyler and I even got to meet bigfoot after the show. He was so kind and sweet and soft. And I promised him I would tell you about his musical. So go and see bigfoot. I promise you'll have a fun time.
